_comment: Random 'event of the day' pool. One weighted, non-repeating flavor event is rolled per day on the task board. Gated by min_day/max_day. (DID facts surface inside situations via surface_fact, not here.)

events.text: A quiet morning. For now, the system feels almost in step — different voices, one direction.
Raised voices carry from next door. Something in them goes quietly alert — an old reflex, not a choice.
A full night's sleep, rare and whole. Today the inner chatter is gentler, more shared than separate.
A date on the calendar tightens something in the chest. No one inside says why, not yet.
